metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 SecurityAndObservability activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "AssociateSecurityGroupVpc", "Set", "VPC",
  "AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress", "Execute", "Security Group",
  "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress", "Execute", "Security Group",
  "CreateFlowLogs", "Create", "Flow Logs",
  "CreateNetworkAcl", "Create", "Network ACL",
  "CreateNetworkAclEntry", "Create", "Network ACL",
  "CreateNetworkInsightsAccessScope", "Create", "Network Insights Access Scope",
  "CreateNetworkInsightsPath", "Create", "Network Insights Path",
  "CreateSecurityGroup", "Create", "Security Group",
  "CreateTrafficMirrorFilter", "Create", "Traffic Mirror Filter",
  "CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRule", "Create", "Traffic Mirror Filter Rule",
  "CreateTrafficMirrorSession", "Create", "Traffic Mirror Session",
  "CreateTrafficMirrorTarget", "Create", "Traffic Mirror Target",
  "CreateVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion", "Create", "VPC BPA Exclusion",
  "CreateVpcEncryptionControl", "Create", "VPC Encryption Control",
  "DeleteFlowLogs", "Delete", "Flow Logs",
  "DeleteNetworkAcl", "Delete", "Network ACL",
  "DeleteNetworkAclEntry", "Set", "Network ACL",
  "DeleteNetworkInsightsAccessScope", "Delete", "Network Insights Access Scope",
  "DeleteNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis", "Delete", "Network Insights Access Scope Analysis",
  "DeleteNetworkInsightsAnalysis", "Delete", "Network Insights Analysis",
  "DeleteNetworkInsightsPath", "Delete", "Network Insights Path",
  "DeleteSecurityGroup", "Delete", "Security Group",
  "DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter", "Delete", "Traffic Mirror Filter",
  "DeleteTrafficMirrorFilterRule", "Delete", "Traffic Mirror Filter Rule",
  "DeleteTrafficMirrorSession", "Delete", "Traffic Mirror Session",
  "DeleteTrafficMirrorTarget", "Delete", "Traffic Mirror Target",
  "DeleteVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion", "Delete", "VPC BPA Exclusion",
  "DeleteVpcEncryptionControl", "Delete", "VPC Encryption Control",
  "DescribeAccountVpcEncryptionControl", "Read", "Account VPC Encryption Control",
  "DescribeFlowLogs", "Read", "Flow Logs",
  "DescribeNetworkAcls", "Read", "Network ACL",
  "DescribeNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalyses", "Read", "Network Insights Access Scope Analysis",
  "DescribeNetworkInsightsAccessScopes", "Read", "Network Insights Access Scope",
  "DescribeNetworkInsightsAnalyses", "Read", "Network Insights Analysis",
  "DescribeNetworkInsightsPaths", "Read", "Network Insights Path",
  "DescribeSecurityGroupReferences", "Read", "Security Group",
  "DescribeSecurityGroupRules", "Read", "Security Group Rule",
  "DescribeSecurityGroupVpcAssociations", "Read", "Security Group VPC Association",
  "DescribeSecurityGroups", "Read", "Security Group",
  "DescribeStaleSecurityGroups", "Read", "VPC",
  "DescribeTrafficMirrorFilterRules", "Read", "Traffic Mirror Filter Rule",
  "DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters", "Read", "Traffic Mirror Filter",
  "DescribeTrafficMirrorSessions", "Read", "Traffic Mirror Session",
  "DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets", "Read", "Traffic Mirror Target",
  "DescribeVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusions", "Read", "VPC BPA Exclusion",
  "DescribeVpcBlockPublicAccessOptions", "Read", "VPC BPA",
  "DescribeVpcEncryptionControls", "Read", "VPC",
  "DisassociateSecurityGroupVpc", "Set", "VPC",
  "EnableReachabilityAnalyzerOrganizationSharing", "Enable", "",
  "GetFlowLogsIntegrationTemplate", "Read", "Flow Logs",
  "GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysisFindings", "Read", "Network Insights Access Scope Analysis",
  "GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeContent", "Read", "Network Insights Access Scope",
  "GetSecurityGroupsForVpc", "Read", "VPC",
  "ModifyAccountVpcEncryptionControl", "Set", "Account VPC Encryption Control",
  "ModifySecurityGroupRules", "Set", "SecurityGroup",
  "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterNetworkServices", "Set", "Traffic Mirror Filter",
  "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterRule", "Set", "Traffic Mirror Filter Rule",
  "ModifyTrafficMirrorSession", "Set", "Traffic Mirror Session",
  "ModifyVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion", "Set", "VPC BPA Exclusion",
  "ModifyVpcBlockPublicAccessOptions", "Set", "VPC BPA",
  "ModifyVpcEncryptionControl", "Set", "VPC Encryption",
  "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation", "Set", "Network ACL",
  "ReplaceNetworkAclEntry", "Set", "Network ACL",
  "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress", "Disable", "Security Group",
  "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress", "Disable", "Security Group",
  "StartNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis", "Start", "Network Insights Access Scope Analysis",
  "StartNetworkInsightsAnalysis", "Start", "Network Insights Analysis",
  "UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress", "Set", "Security Group",
  "UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress", "Set", "Security Group"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName == "AssociateSecurityGroupVpc", Req.GroupId,
    EventName in ("AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress", "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress"),
      Resp.securityGroupRuleSet,
    EventName == "CreateFlowLogs", Resp.unsuccessful,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkAcl", Resp.networkAcl,
    EventName in ("CreateNetworkAclEntry", "DeleteNetworkAclEntry"), Req.RuleNumber,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkInsightsAccessScope", Resp.networkInsightsAccessScopeContent,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkInsightsPath", Resp.networkInsightsPath,
    EventName == "CreateSecurityGroup", Resp.groupId,
    EventName in ("CreateTrafficMirrorFilter", "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterNetworkServices"),
      Resp.trafficMirrorFilter,
    EventName in ("CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRule", "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterRule"),
      Resp.trafficMirrorFilterRule,
    EventName in ("CreateTrafficMirrorSession", "ModifyTrafficMirrorSession"),
      Resp.trafficMirrorSession,
    EventName == "CreateTrafficMirrorTarget", Resp.trafficMirrorTarget,
    EventName in ("CreateVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion", "ModifyVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion"),
      Resp.vpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion,
    EventName in ("CreateVpcEncryptionControl", "ModifyVpcEncryptionControl"),
      Resp.vpcEncryptionControl,
    EventName == "ModifyAccountVpcEncryptionControl", Resp.accountVpcEncryptionControl,
    EventName == "ModifySecurityGroupRules", Req.SecurityGroupRule.N,
    EventName == "ModifyVpcBlockPublicAccessOptions", Resp.vpcBlockPublicAccessOptions,
    EventName == "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation", Resp.newAssociationId,
    EventName in ("RevokeSecurityGroupEgress", "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress"),
      Resp.revokedSecurityGroupRuleSet,
    EventName == "StartNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis",
      Resp.networkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis,
    EventName == "StartNetworkInsightsAnalysis", Resp.networkInsightsAnalysis,
    EventName in ("UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress", "UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress"),
      Req.IpPermissions,
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName in ("AssociateSecurityGroupVpc", "DescribeStaleSecurityGroups", "DescribeVpcEncryptionControls",
      "DisassociateSecurityGroupVpc", "GetSecurityGroupsForVpc"), Req.VpcId,
    EventName in ("AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress", "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress", "DeleteSecurityGroup",
      "DescribeSecurityGroupReferences", "DescribeSecurityGroups", "ModifySecurityGroupRules",
      "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress", "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress", "UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress",
      "UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress"), Req.GroupId,
    EventName == "CreateFlowLogs", Resp.flowLogIdSet,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkAcl", Resp.networkAcl.networkAclId,
    EventName in ("CreateNetworkAclEntry", "DeleteNetworkAcl", "DeleteNetworkAclEntry", "DescribeNetworkAcls",
      "ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation", "ReplaceNetworkAclEntry"), Req.NetworkAclId,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkInsightsAccessScope",
      Resp.networkInsightsAccessScope.networkInsightsAccessScopeId,
    EventName == "CreateNetworkInsightsPath", Resp.networkInsightsPath.networkInsightsPathId,
    EventName == "CreateSecurityGroup", Resp.groupId,
    EventName == "CreateTrafficMirrorFilter", Resp.trafficMirrorFilter.trafficMirrorFilterId,
    EventName == "CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRule",
      Resp.trafficMirrorFilterRule.trafficMirrorFilterRuleId,
    EventName == "CreateTrafficMirrorSession", Resp.trafficMirrorSession.trafficMirrorSessionId,
    EventName == "CreateTrafficMirrorTarget", Resp.trafficMirrorTarget.trafficMirrorTargetId,
    EventName == "CreateVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion",
      Resp.vpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion.vpcBlockPublicAccessExclusionId,
    EventName == "CreateVpcEncryptionControl", Resp.vpcEncryptionControl.vpcEncryptionControlId,
    EventName in ("DeleteFlowLogs", "DescribeFlowLogs", "GetFlowLogsIntegrationTemplate"),
      Req.FlowLogId,
    EventName == "DeleteNetworkInsightsAccessScope", Resp.networkInsightsAccessScopeId,
    EventName in ("DeleteNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis",
      "GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysisFindings"), Resp.networkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysisId,
    EventName == "DeleteNetworkInsightsAnalysis", Resp.networkInsightsAnalysisId,
    EventName == "DeleteNetworkInsightsPath", Resp.networkInsightsPathId,
    EventName in ("DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter", "DescribeTrafficMirrorFilters",
      "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterNetworkServices"), Req.TrafficMirrorFilterId,
    EventName in ("DeleteTrafficMirrorFilterRule", "DescribeTrafficMirrorFilterRules",
      "ModifyTrafficMirrorFilterRule"), Req.TrafficMirrorFilterRuleId,
    EventName in ("DeleteTrafficMirrorSession", "DescribeTrafficMirrorSessions",
      "ModifyTrafficMirrorSession"), Req.TrafficMirrorSessionId,
    EventName in ("DeleteTrafficMirrorTarget", "DescribeTrafficMirrorTargets"),
      Req.TrafficMirrorTargetId,
    EventName in ("DeleteVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion", "DescribeVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusions",
      "ModifyVpcBlockPublicAccessExclusion"), Req.ExclusionId,
    EventName in ("DeleteVpcEncryptionControl", "ModifyVpcEncryptionControl"),
      Req.VpcEncryptionControlId,
    EventName == "DescribeNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalyses",
      Req.NetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysisId,
    EventName in ("DescribeNetworkInsightsAccessScopes", "GetNetworkInsightsAccessScopeContent",
      "StartNetworkInsightsAccessScopeAnalysis"), Req.NetworkInsightsAccessScopeId,
    EventName == "DescribeNetworkInsightsAnalyses", Req.NetworkInsightsAnalysisId,
    EventName in ("DescribeNetworkInsightsPaths", "StartNetworkInsightsAnalysis"),
      Req.NetworkInsightsPathId,
    EventName == "DescribeSecurityGroupRules", Req.SecurityGroupRuleId,
    EventName == "DescribeVpcBlockPublicAccessOptions", Req.VpcIds,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
